_comment: Phase 1 (RL SOTA) — stock Gemma sanity gate. Each prompt has objective pass criteria. Run via scripts/run-gemma-sanity-gate.sh against a local Gemma-3-4B-it Q4_K_M GGUF. Expected pass rate: 20/20 (allow 18/20 if a prompt's expect_substring needs tuning). 20/20 = Gemma is good enough to be the base for Phase 2 (DPO/KTO/GRPO training).
